title: Phenotype vs Genotype
text: Unlike complete dominance where heterozygotes look the same as dominant homozygotes, in incomplete dominance the phenotypic ratio equals the genotypic ratio.

title: Count Each Phenotype
text: From 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr, you get 1 red (RR) : 2 pink (Rr) : 1 white (rr).
